name: pixera-mcp
description: Control and set up AV Stumpfl Pixera over its JSON/TCP API, plus offline projection-mapping guidance.
long_description:
Talks to Pixera's Native API (JSON/TCP(dl)). Inspect and build screens, resources, timelines and layers, assign 3D models, move projector mappings between outputs, call any API method with offline validation, and get projection-mapping and marker-calibration guidance.

In Pixera: Settings > API, add a JSON/TCP(dl) port (default here 1500) and switch off 'Restrict Web Access To Actions That Match Allowlist'. The API has no authentication: use it only on a trusted show network.

The extension updates itself from the GitHub releases of the repository on start (can be switched off in the settings).

pixera_host.title: Pixera host
pixera_host.description: IP or hostname of the Pixera machine.

pixera_port.title: Pixera API port
pixera_port.description: JSON/TCP(dl) port set in Pixera's API settings.

protected_prefixes.title: Protected timeline prefixes
protected_prefixes.description: Comma-separated timeline name prefixes the tools never remove or rename. Leave empty to protect nothing.

auto_update.title: Update from GitHub on start
auto_update.description: Download the latest release from github.com/LMXtinker/pixera-mcp when Claude starts the extension.
